admission.justification: Publishing against a moved branch or foreign head would put the wrong tree on the contract branch.

applicability: Ordinary and direct closeout publication on converted memory.
conditions: The closeout judged a tree from the admitted contract branch and captured the parent before publication.
exclusions: A caller outside closeout publication; the primitive is not re-used there.
statement: Closeout publishes only on the contract work branch with the parent observed before the admitted tree was captured.
